【Course Format】
★The format for the course will consist of lectures, group learning（pair work and group work), discussion, and presentation. As class discussion is an integral part of the learning process, students are expected to come to class ready to discuss the required reading.
★All course material, assignments, and other related information will be uploaded in Moodle, so please check it regularly.
【Proportion of English】
I would strongly encourage students to use English as much as possible.
①　Language spoken by the instructor:100％
②　Language use for slides:100％
③　Discussion and Q＆A: English and Japanese, and recommend using English as much
④　Student group presentation and Q＆A for the presentation:100％
⑤　Q＆A for instructor: Both English and Japanese possible
⑥　Individual report: Both English and Japanese possible
⑦　Group assignment: 100％

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: 世界における保健医療システムを多様な視点から概観しながら、地球規模の健康課題（グローバルヘルス）を解決するための取り組みに関して考察できるようになる。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: Students will be able to consider initiative to solve global health issues while gaining an overview of the world's health care systems from various perspectives.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: Health system, international cooperation, Well-being, Social determinants of health
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件: 第１回目授業までにMoodleに登録しておくこと。第１回目授業と第７・８回目のグループプレゼンテーションに出席できない場合、単位取得は難しい（聴講は可能）You must be able to attend the first, seventh, and eighth sessions. If you cannot, you will not be able to get credit for this course.
